title: Extended State Observer
text: Estimate states and disturbances of a system, 8 inputs, 2 outputs, {Time delay} sets time delays; {Time domain} sets the controller time domain, {LTI state-space variable} sets the known plant dynamics, {Use external source for model matrices (A,Bu,Cm)} sets the model matrices at block input ports, {Number of states}, {Number of inputs}, {Number of outputs}, {Specify gain k (such that Bd = k*Bu)} sets the gain value for computing disturbance input, {Use external source for matrix Bd} sets the disturbance matrix at block input port, {Number of disturbances}, {Initial conditions}, {Use external source for initial conditions S0 (x0,d0)} sets the initial conditions at block input port, {Bandwidth (rad/s)} sets the observer bandwidth, {Spacing (rad/s)} sets the observer bandwidth spacing, {Use external source for matrix L} sets the observer matrix at block input port, {Data type} sets the floating point precision and {Output estimated model states xhat} sets the output estimated states at block output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: LTI state-space variable
params.values: Known plant dynamics ss object | idss object

params.name: Use external source for model matrices (A,Bu,Cm)
params.values: Specify model matrices at block input ports off (default) | on

params.name: Number of states
params.values: Number of states in the model 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of inputs
params.values: Number of inputs in the model 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of outputs
params.values: Number of outputs in the model 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Specify gain k (such that Bd = k*Bu)
params.values: Gain value for computing disturbance input matrix 1 (default) | nonzero scalar

params.name: Use external source for matrix Bd
params.values: Specify disturbance matrix at block input port off (default) | on

params.name: Number of disturbances
params.values: Number of disturbances in the model 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Initial conditions
params.values: Initial conditions for the extended states 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Use external source for initial conditions S0 (x0,d0)
params.values: Specify initial conditions at block input port off (default) | on

params.name: Use external source for matrix L
params.values: Specify observer matrix at block input port off (default) | on

params.name: Time delay
params.values: Specify time delays 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector

params.name: Output estimated model states xhat
params.values: Output estimated states at block output port on (default) | off
